messages:
maria (docs): Heads-up — the current "EU data residency" note on /platform/regions is ambiguous. Legal flagged that the copy implies residency is automatic; it isn't. We should clarify the process and link to the contractual addendum.
kevin (product): +1. Had a customer confusion this morning. Can we add a short footnote and an SDK snippet showing explicit region selection? :eyes:
sam (eng-docs): I can open a PR. Proposed wording: 'Data residency in the EU is available only via an executed Data Residency Addendum (DRA); default hosted accounts may have data processed across our global infrastructure.' Will add link to the DRA page. Any preferred phrasing?
leo (legal): That phrasing works. Also call out that Dedicated/Private deployments have different guarantees. Suggest: 'EU data residency is provided only with an executed Data Residency Addendum (DRA). Hosted accounts without a DRA may have data processed or routed through other regions.' Keep it concise.
maria (docs): Perfect. Sam — can you add two things in the docs PR: 1) a numbered footnote below the "region availability" table that links to the DRA page, 2) an SDK snippet (JS + Python) showing the explicit region param and a short note that setting the param does NOT substitute for an executed DRA.
sam (eng-docs): Yep. Drafting now. Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — will include:
```js
// preferRegion example (JS SDK)
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, preferRegion: 'eu-west-1' });
await client.text.generate({ prompt: 'hello' });
```
And a Python example as well (same pattern).
kevin (product): Can you also add a short migration note for customers who previously relied on the old 'eu' alias? We renamed some region slugs; need a tiny mapping table (old -> new).
maria (docs): Good call. Keep the table minimal and add a one-line note: 'If you rely on the alias "eu" please map to the new explicit region slug or upgrade SDK.' Also add an SDK minimum-version note: older clients (v0.9.x) ignore preferRegion.
sam (eng-docs): Added the mapping and version table in the PR. I put the legal-approved phrasing under a separate admonition starting with 'Note —'.
leo (legal): Approved. One tweak: change 'may be processed' -> 'may be processed or routed through' in the main sentence.
sam (eng-docs): Updated that string in the PR.
maria (docs): @kevin can you do a quick product review? If green I'll merge after CI.
kevin (product): Reviewing now.
deploy-bot: CI passed for docs PR #482 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/98765
kevin (product): LGTM :rocket:
maria (docs): Merged. I'll add a small redirect from /region/eu to the new page so inbound links don't 404.
docs-bot: PR 482 merged by maria (docs) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :white_check_mark:
maria (docs): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a release note in #announcements once the site deploys.
kevin (product): Thanks!
